description:
Nasayem is a 38 m (125 ft) motor yacht built in the United Arab Emirates by Obaid Juma bin Suloom Est. and launched in 2011, with a white teak wood hull, an 8.77 m beam and a gross tonnage of 185 GT. She is offered for sale in Dubai and lies at Mina Rashid (Port Rashid).

She is licensed to carry 46 passengers, which sets her apart from most yachts available in Dubai. With three decks, a large saloon, a dining hall and a covered upper deck lounge, she hosts big groups in comfort. This makes Nasayem an excellent choice for an owner who wants to run her as a charter yacht in Dubai, for private cruises, events or corporate hospitality, as well as for private use.

Power comes from twin 885 hp Caterpillar 3412 engines showing only 741 and 733 running hours, with a maximum speed of 13.2 knots achieved during sea trials. They are backed by two Onan generators (75 kVA and 50 kVA), central air conditioning with two chillers, a watermaker, three battery chargers and three fresh water pumps.

The upper deck combines the wheelhouse, with Northstar GPS, autopilot, hydraulic power steering, VHF and a Thuraya satellite phone, with a master bedroom and a large covered lounge. The main deck offers a saloon with a music system, a dining hall, a pantry, a guest toilet and a second master bedroom, with the galley and crew room forward.

Below, the lower deck has a master bedroom with its own bathroom and four guest cabins, all with TV and two with private bathrooms, plus a storeroom with two freezers. Two separate crew cabins with their own air conditioning complete the layout.
